Server Script.name: hvs_create_snapshot
Server Script.script:
title = frappe.form_dict.get("title") or "수동 전체 백업"
pos = [frappe.get_doc("Purchase Order", n).as_dict() for n in frappe.get_all("Purchase Order", pluck="name")]
assets = [frappe.get_doc("Asset", n).as_dict() for n in frappe.get_all("Asset", pluck="name")]
ams = [frappe.get_doc("Asset Maintenance", n).as_dict() for n in frappe.get_all("Asset Maintenance", pluck="name")]
am_logs = [frappe.get_doc("Asset Maintenance Log", n).as_dict() for n in frappe.get_all("Asset Maintenance Log", pluck="name")]
repairs = [frappe.get_doc("Asset Repair", n).as_dict() for n in frappe.get_all("Asset Repair", pluck="name")]
pinvs = [frappe.get_doc("Purchase Invoice", n).as_dict() for n in frappe.get_all("Purchase Invoice", pluck="name")]
suppliers = [frappe.get_doc("Supplier", n).as_dict() for n in frappe.get_all("Supplier", pluck="name")]
items = [frappe.get_doc("Item", n).as_dict() for n in frappe.get_all("Item", pluck="name")]
ui_configs = [frappe.get_doc("HVS UI Config", n).as_dict() for n in frappe.get_all("HVS UI Config", pluck="name")]

payload = {
    "pos": pos,
    "assets": assets,
    "ams": ams,
    "am_logs": am_logs,
    "repairs": repairs,
    "pinvs": pinvs,
    "suppliers": suppliers,
    "items": items,
    "ui_configs": ui_configs
}
summary = f"발주 {len(pos)}건 · 장비 {len(assets)}대 · 수리보고서 {len(repairs)}건 · PM {len(am_logs)}건"
snap = frappe.get_doc({
    "doctype": "HVS Backup Snapshot",
    "backup_title": title,
    "backup_time": frappe.utils.now_datetime(),
    "summary_info": summary,
    "snapshot_json": as_json(payload)
})
snap.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
frappe.response["message"] = {"name": snap.name, "summary": summary}

Server Script.name: hvs_delete_doc
hvs_restore_snapshot
Server Script.script:
snap_name = frappe.form_dict.get("snap_name")
raw_json = frappe.form_dict.get("raw_json")
if raw_json:
    data = json.loads(raw_json)
else:
    snap_doc = frappe.get_doc("HVS Backup Snapshot", snap_name)
    data = json.loads(snap_doc.snapshot_json)

# 1. Clear current records cleanly (unlink PI/PR items from PO first)
for pi_item in frappe.get_all("Purchase Invoice Item", pluck="name"):
    frappe.db.set_value("Purchase Invoice Item", pi_item, "purchase_order", None)
for pr_item in frappe.get_all("Purchase Receipt Item", pluck="name"):
    frappe.db.set_value("Purchase Receipt Item", pr_item, "purchase_order", None)

for dt in ["Asset Repair", "Asset Maintenance Log", "Asset Maintenance", "Asset Movement", "Asset", "Purchase Order"]:
    for n in frappe.get_all(dt, pluck="name"):
        if dt in ["Asset Repair", "Asset Maintenance Log", "Asset Movement", "Asset", "Purchase Order"]:
            frappe.db.set_value(dt, n, "docstatus", 2)
        frappe.delete_doc(dt, n, force=1, ignore_permissions=True)

# 2. Re-insert Suppliers & Items if missing
for s in data.get("suppliers", []):
    if not frappe.db.exists("Supplier", s.get("name")):
        s_clean = dict(s)
        s_clean["doctype"] = "Supplier"
        frappe.get_doc(s_clean).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

for it in data.get("items", []):
    if not frappe.db.exists("Item", it.get("name")):
        it_clean = dict(it)
        it_clean["doctype"] = "Item"
        frappe.get_doc(it_clean).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

# 3. Restore Purchase Orders
for po in data.get("pos", []):
    orig_status = po.get("status")
    orig_per = po.get("per_received", 0)
    orig_docstatus = po.get("docstatus", 1)
    po_clean = {
        "doctype": "Purchase Order",
        "company": po.get("company") or "하이버스",
        "supplier": po.get("supplier"),
        "supplier_name": po.get("supplier_name"),
        "transaction_date": po.get("transaction_date"),
        "schedule_date": po.get("schedule_date"),
        "custom_po_category": po.get("custom_po_category"),
        "custom_target_line": po.get("custom_target_line"),
        "custom_target_machine": po.get("custom_target_machine"),
        "custom_delivery_stage": po.get("custom_delivery_stage"),
        "custom_payment_milestone": po.get("custom_payment_milestone"),
        "custom_sub_gantt_json": po.get("custom_sub_gantt_json"),
        "items": []
    }
    for item in po.get("items", []):
        po_clean["items"].append({
            "item_code": item.get("item_code"),
            "item_name": item.get("item_name"),
            "qty": item.get("qty", 1),
            "rate": item.get("rate", 0),
            "schedule_date": item.get("schedule_date") or po.get("schedule_date"),
            "warehouse": item.get("warehouse")
        })
    po_doc = frappe.get_doc(po_clean)
    po_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True, set_name=po.get("name"))
    if orig_docstatus == 1:
        po_doc.submit()
    if orig_status:
        frappe.db.set_value("Purchase Order", po_doc.name, {"status": orig_status, "per_received": orig_per})

# 4. Restore Assets (including Equipment Spare Parts table)
for ast in data.get("assets", []):
    orig_docstatus = ast.get("docstatus", 1)
    ast_clean = {
        "doctype": "Asset",
        "company": ast.get("company") or "하이버스",
        "item_code": ast.get("item_code"),
        "asset_name": ast.get("asset_name"),
        "location": ast.get("location") or "A동 1라인 (CNC 선반 공정)",
        "asset_category": ast.get("asset_category") or "CNC·MCT 핵심가공설비",
        "purchase_date": ast.get("purchase_date") or ast.get("custom_arrival_date"),
        "available_for_use_date": ast.get("available_for_use_date") or ast.get("custom_commissioning_date"),
        "net_purchase_amount": ast.get("net_purchase_amount") or 100000000,
        "asset_quantity": ast.get("asset_quantity") or 1,
        "maintenance_required": 1,
        "calculate_depreciation": 0,
        "is_existing_asset": 1,
        "asset_type": "Existing Asset",
        "custom_machine_no": ast.get("custom_machine_no"),
        "custom_line_name": ast.get("custom_line_name"),
        "custom_equipment_type": ast.get("custom_equipment_type"),
        "custom_maker": ast.get("custom_maker"),
        "custom_model_no": ast.get("custom_model_no"),
        "custom_controller_spec": ast.get("custom_controller_spec"),
        "custom_arrival_date": ast.get("custom_arrival_date"),
        "custom_commissioning_date": ast.get("custom_commissioning_date"),
        "custom_installation_status": ast.get("custom_installation_status"),
        "custom_chk_utility": ast.get("custom_chk_utility"),
        "custom_chk_leveling": ast.get("custom_chk_leveling"),
        "custom_chk_test_cut": ast.get("custom_chk_test_cut"),
        "custom_chk_training": ast.get("custom_chk_training"),
        "custom_commissioning_report": ast.get("custom_commissioning_report"),
        "custom_pm_cycle_summary": ast.get("custom_pm_cycle_summary"),
        "custom_next_pm_date": ast.get("custom_next_pm_date"),
        "custom_spare_parts": []
    }
    for sp in ast.get("custom_spare_parts", []):
        ast_clean["custom_spare_parts"].append({
            "part_item": sp.get("part_item"),
            "part_name": sp.get("part_name"),
            "part_spec": sp.get("part_spec"),
            "unit_price": sp.get("unit_price"),
            "qty_per_machine": sp.get("qty_per_machine"),
            "pm_cycle": sp.get("pm_cycle"),
            "supplier": sp.get("supplier"),
            "lead_time_days": sp.get("lead_time_days"),
            "remarks": sp.get("remarks")
        })
    ast_doc = frappe.get_doc(ast_clean)
    ast_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True, set_name=ast.get("name"))
    if orig_docstatus == 1:
        ast_doc.submit()

# 5. Restore Asset Maintenance (PM Plans)
for am in data.get("ams", []):
    am_clean = {
        "doctype": "Asset Maintenance",
        "company": am.get("company") or "하이버스",
        "asset_name": am.get("asset_name"),
        "maintenance_team": am.get("maintenance_team") or "신공장 설비보전·PM 전담팀",
        "asset_maintenance_tasks": []
    }
    for t in am.get("asset_maintenance_tasks", []):
        am_clean["asset_maintenance_tasks"].append({
            "maintenance_task": t.get("maintenance_task"),
            "maintenance_type": t.get("maintenance_type") or "Preventive Maintenance",
            "maintenance_status": t.get("maintenance_status") or "Planned",
            "periodicity": t.get("periodicity") or "Monthly",
            "start_date": t.get("start_date"),
            "next_due_date": t.get("next_due_date"),
            "assign_to": t.get("assign_to") or "Administrator",
            "description": t.get("description")
        })
    if am_clean["asset_maintenance_tasks"] and frappe.db.exists("Asset", am_clean["asset_name"]):
        frappe.get_doc(am_clean).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

for aml in data.get("am_logs", []):
    matched = frappe.get_all("Asset Maintenance Log", filters={"asset_name": aml.get("asset_name"), "task_name": aml.get("task_name")}, pluck="name")
    if matched:
        frappe.db.set_value("Asset Maintenance Log", matched[0], {
            "maintenance_status": aml.get("maintenance_status") or "Planned",
            "due_date": aml.get("due_date"),
            "completion_date": aml.get("completion_date"),
            "actions_performed": aml.get("actions_performed")
        })

# 6. Restore Asset Repairs (Technical Reports)
for ar in data.get("repairs", []):
    if frappe.db.exists("Asset", ar.get("asset")):
        ar_clean = {
            "doctype": "Asset Repair",
            "company": ar.get("company") or "하이버스",
            "asset": ar.get("asset"),
            "failure_date": ar.get("failure_date"),
            "completion_date": ar.get("completion_date"),
            "repair_status": ar.get("repair_status") or "Completed",
            "custom_doc_no": ar.get("custom_doc_no"),
            "custom_failure_category": ar.get("custom_failure_category"),
            "custom_alarm_code": ar.get("custom_alarm_code"),
            "custom_engineer_name": ar.get("custom_engineer_name"),
            "repair_cost": ar.get("repair_cost") or 0,
            "description": ar.get("description"),
            "custom_root_cause": ar.get("custom_root_cause"),
            "actions_performed": ar.get("actions_performed"),
            "custom_technical_parameters": ar.get("custom_technical_parameters"),
            "custom_preventive_action": ar.get("custom_preventive_action")
        }
        ar_doc = frappe.get_doc(ar_clean)
        ar_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True, set_name=ar.get("name"))

# 7. Restore UI Configs if included in snapshot
for uc in data.get("ui_configs", []):
    ck = uc.get("config_key") or uc.get("name")
    if ck:
        if frappe.db.exists("HVS UI Config", ck):
            frappe.db.set_value("HVS UI Config", ck, "config_json", uc.get("config_json"))
        else:
            frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "HVS UI Config",
                "config_key": ck,
                "config_json": uc.get("config_json")
            }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

frappe.response["message"] = "restored"
